scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @nbase/server" "npm run dev --workspace @nbase/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nbase/contracts && npm run build --workspace @nbase/server && npm run build --workspace @nbase/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nbase/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @nbase/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:backup
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
